extName.message: Sinkro — Watch Party: Sync Any Video With Friends

extDescription.message: Free, open-source watch party extension that keeps any video on any website in sync with your friends.

found.message: Found a video on this tab

createHelp.message: You get a link to share. Anyone who opens it watches this video with you, in sync.

footer.message: No account. Only playback state, a random name, and the video's address and title are shared.

noVideo.message: No video on this page yet

pickerHint.message: Click the video you want to sync

onboardTitle.message: Same movie. Same second. Different couches.

pageUnavailable.message: Open a video to create a room. You can still join with a code.

badCode.message: That doesn't look like a room code or invite link.

cantReach.message: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

connLostHelp.message: Reconnecting. You'll catch up with the room when it's back.

needsGesture.message: Click the video to join in

needsGestureHelp.message: Your browser wants a click before it plays anything on this page.

noVideoHelp.message: It may still be loading. Press play, or point Sinkro at it.

roomGoneHelp.message: Rooms close a day after everyone leaves, or after 12 quiet hours. Ask for a new link, or create a room.

roomFullHelp.message: It has reached its limit of people. Someone needs to leave first.

updateNeededHelp.message: This server runs a different version. Updating the extension usually fixes it.

serverHelp.message: Leave it empty to use Sinkro's server. Running your own? Put its address here. It applies to the next room you join.

serverInvalid.message: Enter a full address that starts with http:// or https://.

tooManyRooms.message: You've created a lot of rooms. Wait a minute and try again.

adPlayingHelp.message: Everyone else carries on. You'll catch up with them when it ends.

openVideoHere.message: Open the video in this tab

openVideoHereHelp.message: You're in the room. Sync starts once this tab is on the video's page.

adPlayingAloneHelp.message: Sync picks up again when it ends.

cantFollow.message: This video can't follow the room

cantFollowHelp.message: It may be an ad, or a different video or source. You'll catch up when the room's video is back.

pastEnd.message: This video ends before the room's spot

pastEndHelp.message: You may be on a different video or source. Sinkro won't move it until the room is back in range.

badgeMoveHint.message: Drag the badge, or use the arrow keys. Esc cancels.

inRoomGoHelp.message: The video won't open by itself. Press the button below to go to it.

youMovedHelp.message: The room is still on the previous one, and nothing you do here reaches it.

roomMoved.message: The room moved to another video

roomMovedHelp.message: You stay here until you choose to go.

roomIdleHelp.message: Nothing was played, paused or moved for 12 hours. Create a new room to keep watching.

othersOnAdHelp.message: You're still watching. Pause if you'd like to wait for them.

othersOnAdPausedHelp.message: The video is paused. You'll hear when the ad ends.

startPlayerHelp.message: Press play on the site's player. Syncing starts once the video opens.

youMovedFloatingHelp.message: The room is on the previous one. To bring everyone, open this video's own page first.

floatingPlayerHelp.message: Sync carries on. To bring everyone here, open the video's own page first.

sourceMismatch.message: This may be a different source

sourceMismatchHelp.message: Yours is $MINE$ long and the others' is $ROOM$. Everyone should pick the same player.

sourceMismatchHostHelp.message: Yours is $MINE$ long and the others' is $ROOM$, from $HOST$. Everyone should pick the same player.

othersBehind.message: $HERE$ of $TOTAL$ people are on this video

oneBehindHelp.message: One person is on another page.

everyoneLeftHelp.message: To make this the room's video, press Bring everyone here. Anyone already on this page joins by themselves.

serverSetup.message: How to run your own server (GitHub)

liveNoticeHelp.message: Everyone watches from their own live point, so Sinkro doesn't pause or move anyone here. It still shows who's on another page.

nameAdjectives.description: Sixteen adjectives for random names, separated by |. Same count and order in every language.

nameAnimals.description: Sixteen animals for random names, separated by |. Same count and order in every language.

showReactionsHelp.message: Emoji from the people in the room, on the video.

personUnnamed.description: Someone in the room whose name isn't known, as with an older version.

roomPageEmptyHelp.message: The room was started on a page with no video. Bring everyone here, and the invite link will lead to this video too.
